Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Record Class SocialProperties.Provider

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.SocialProperties.Provider
Record Components:
clientId - client id registered with the provider; blank leaves the provider disabled.
clientSecret - client secret (Google, Microsoft, GitHub), supplied from the environment.
trustMfa - whether the provider's amr claim is trusted to prove several factors (default false).
tenant - Entra ID tenant: common (the default), organizations, consumers, or a tenant id or domain.
allowedTenants - tenant ids an Entra ID multi-tenant sign-in is limited to; empty accepts any tenant.
teamId - Apple developer team id.
keyId - id of the Apple key the client secret is signed with.
privateKey - PKCS#8 PEM private key (ES256) Apple issued, supplied from the environment; a literal \n stands for a line break.
clientSecretTtl - lifetime of the client secret JWT sent to Apple (default five minutes, at most six months).
Enclosing class:
SocialProperties
public static record SocialProperties.Provider(String clientId, String clientSecret, boolean trustMfa, String tenant, List<String> allowedTenants, String teamId, String keyId, String privateKey, Duration clientSecretTtl) extends Record
Settings of one provider. Only the ones that apply to the provider are read: the client secret by Google, Microsoft and GitHub, the tenant settings by Microsoft and the key settings by Apple (whose client secret is a JWT signed with the private key).
